page.overview:
What is Dan Tien Dao?

Dan Tien Dao is a weapon used by Shujinko in Mortal Kombat: Deception and Mortal Kombat: Armageddon. Technically the Quadspade is a Dan Tien Dao as well. When Shujinko executes any of his Mortal Kombat: Deception Fatalities, he will use two Dan Tien Daos.
